title: Nonzero universal principal-minor relations and finite-free algebra units certify a characteristic-zero obstruction

statement.quantifiers: The exact rational maximal-contact four-log multiaffine fixture P4 and any matrix size with every variable coefficient of rank at most one.
statement.assertion: P4 has no determinant representation of this rank-one-variable class over C. A universal Nanson relation evaluates5mod101; a separate rank8 finite-free quotient residual has multiplication determinant17mod101.
assumptions: Nonzero full monomial coefficient allows reduction to a4-dimensional principal-minor problem.
Second certificate uses monic quadratics over Z_(101); the residual is a unit, not merely nonzero at sampled finite-field points.

inputs: Exact rational P4 coefficients, principal-minor cycle data and universal identity or finite-free multiplication matrix.
outputs: Exact finite no-go for one determinant compression route.
interface.precision: Integer/rational identities and residue-unit certificate; finite-field point absence alone does not prove absence over C.
costs: Finite fixture coefficient bits are charged; no uniform polynomial-size family derived.
Published Nanson/principal-minor identity imported and credited.

proof_mechanism: Independent rank-one factors and an invertible complement reduce arbitrary matrix size by Schur complement.
Evaluate the universal integer principal-minor identity to a nonzero rational via mod101.
Independently construct a rank8 finite-free algebra from3 monic quadratics.
An invertible residual multiplication matrix makes the residual a unit and excludes any characteristic-zero zero specialization.
obstructions: General determinants with repeated variables and other small circuits are not excluded.
Four finite contact fixtures do not decide general small-circuit contact.
Source independent exact checks remain internally reported, not external proof certification.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Identify a universal identity or a valid finite-free specialization argument; do not promote finite-field point searches to algebraic-closure impossibility.

review.source_reported: Source separate internal reconstructions and scoped exact checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
